# Aastha Supports

> Authentic and Vedic-energised spiritual products — rudraksha, malas, bracelets, gemstones, yantras (certification available on request) — plus upcoming online pooja services.

Aastha Supports sources rudraksha and gemstones directly from verified origins (Nepal, Indonesia, India), provides lab testing certificates on request, and energises products through traditional Vedic abhimantran rituals before pan-India dispatch. Free astrological guidance is offered with every inquiry.
